newsitem.title: USA: Damage from freeze is variable in citrus belt - FASS.
newsitem.headline: Damage from freeze is variable in citrus belt - FASS.

text.p: Damage from freezing temperatures Jan 19 varied according to location, tree condition, stage of growth and moisture levels at the time of the freeze, said Florida Agricultural Statistics Service.
According to FASS, harvesting crews are moving damaged early maturing crops to the processing plant and fresh fruit packing houses have sufficient fruit to meet current commitments.
Caretakers in the area are discing and cutting dead cover crops for fire prevention.
FASS reported an estimated 180,000 boxes of navel oranges were harvested in the week ended Jan 26, down from 266,000 boxes the previous week and 222,000 boxes in the week ended January 12.
An estimated 7,308,000 boxes of early and mid oranges were harvested in the week ended Jan 26, down from 11,053,000 boxes the prior week and 9,352,000 boxes the week ended Jan 12.
